cta.title: Ready to Start Learning {name}?
cta.description: Give your child the tools to succeed with fun, curriculum-aligned {name} activities.

math.name: Mathematics
math.heroDescription: Build strong math foundations with interactive games, puzzles, and activities designed for Pre-K through Grade 7.
math.description: Build number sense, master arithmetic, explore geometry, and solve real-world problems through engaging games and activities.

features.title: Builds Problem Solving
features.description: Develop critical thinking and logical reasoning through real-world math challenges and puzzles.

features.title: Adaptive Learning
features.description: Activities automatically adjust difficulty based on your child's skill level and progress.

features.title: Real-World Application
features.description: Learn math through practical scenarios like shopping, cooking, and measuring that kids encounter daily.

features.title: Progress Tracking
features.description: Visual dashboards and achievement badges keep kids motivated and parents informed.

reading.name: Your AI-Buddy
reading.heroDescription: Spark a lifelong love of reading with phonics, vocabulary, comprehension, and writing activities for Pre-K through Grade 7.
reading.description: AI-powered feature combines friendly interaction, communication skills, general knowledge, and guides children on exploring the outside world — creating a fun, engaging, and educational experience all in one place.

features.title: Builds Literacy
features.description: Structured phonics and reading programs that develop confident, independent readers step by step.

features.title: Sparks Imagination
features.description: Interactive stories and creative writing prompts that nurture a love of reading and self-expression.

features.title: Communication Skills
features.description: Grammar, vocabulary, and writing exercises that strengthen how kids express their ideas.

features.title: Progress Tracking
features.description: Visual dashboards and achievement badges keep kids motivated and parents informed.

science.name: Craft & Drawing
science.heroDescription: Unleash creativity with hands-on craft projects, drawing activities, and interactive art exercises for K through Grade 7.
science.description: Unleash creativity through hands-on craft projects, drawing tutorials, and interactive art activities covering painting, origami, and creative design.

features.title: Nurtures Curiosity
features.description: Hands-on experiments and discovery-based activities that encourage kids to ask questions and explore.

features.title: Scientific Thinking
features.description: Learn the scientific method through observation, hypothesis, and experimentation activities.

features.title: Real-World Connections
features.description: Explore topics like weather, animals, and space that connect classroom learning to the world around them.

features.title: Progress Tracking
features.description: Visual dashboards and achievement badges keep kids motivated and parents informed.

craft-drawing.name: Craft & Drawing
craft-drawing.heroDescription: Unleash creativity through fun drawing lessons, paper crafts, and hands-on art activities that build fine motor skills, imagination, and self-expression.
craft-drawing.description: From pencil sketching to paper crafts, our creative activities help children develop artistic skills, fine motor control, and imaginative thinking in a fun, guided environment.

features.title: Builds Creativity
features.description: Art activities encourage original thinking, imagination, and the confidence to express ideas visually.

features.title: Fine Motor Skills
features.description: Cutting, folding, drawing, and moulding strengthen hand-eye coordination and dexterity.

features.title: Emotional Expression
features.description: Art provides a safe outlet for children to express feelings, build self-esteem, and develop mindfulness.

features.title: Progress Tracking
features.description: Visual portfolios and achievement badges keep kids motivated and parents informed about creative growth.
